meta.name: copywriting-ic-sequence
meta.description: Writes a 3-email outbound sequence targeting Individual Contributors (SDR, AE, BDR, Account Manager, Marketing Specialist, Sales Rep, RevOps Analyst, CS Rep, etc.). Use this skill whenever the user wants to write cold emails for an IC, says "write me a sequence for SDRs", "draft emails targeting AEs", "emails for individual contributors", or provides an IC persona and asks for outreach copy. Always produces a complete 3-email campaign following strict copywriting rules, calibrated for personal, day-in-the-life IC messaging that earns a reply without going over their head.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为个人贡献者撰写3封冷邮件序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要针对SDR、AE等个人贡献者角色撰写高回复率的冷邮件序列。
copy.tagline_en: Write a 3-email outbound sequence targeting individual contributors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write high-reply cold email sequences for IC roles like SDRs and AEs.

howto.what: 用户要求后，Claude 会写一套 3 封邮件的冷邮件序列，针对个体贡献者（如 SDR、AE、CS 代表等）。序列遵循严格的文案规则，聚焦于 IC 的日常痛点和内部 champion 角色。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求写针对 IC 的冷邮件，或说出“write me a sequence for SDRs”、“draft emails targeting AEs”等指令，或提供 IC 角色并要求外联文案时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一套针对SDR的冷邮件序列。
say.note: Claude 会先收集上下文然后生成三封邮件。

say.text: 给AE写三封跟进邮件，聚焦他们日常的难点。
say.note: Claude 会按 IC 规则写出低门槛 CTA 的邮件。

say.text: 写一套面向客户成功代表的开发邮件系列。

howto.what_en: When asked, Claude writes a 3-email outbound sequence targeting Individual Contributors (e.g., SDR, AE, CS Rep). The sequence follows strict copy rules, focusing on ICs' daily friction and internal champion positioning.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks for a cold email sequence targeting ICs, or says phrases like "write me a sequence for SDRs", "draft emails targeting AEs", or provides an IC persona and requests outreach copy.

say_en.text: Write a cold email sequence for SDRs.
say_en.note: Claude will collect context and generate three emails.

say_en.text: Draft three follow-up emails for AEs focusing on their daily struggles.
say_en.note: Claude follows IC rules with low-friction CTAs.

say_en.text: Create an outreach email series for CS Reps.
say_en.note: Claude customizes pain points and champion angle for CS role.
